units.source_text: 八月十六日的“大字”，就是送神的篝火。

en.t: The "Dai" character on August sixteenth is a bonfire for sending off the spirits.

units.source_text: 传说从前有这样的风俗：夜里将火把抛上空中，

en.t: It is said that in the past there was such a custom: at night, people would throw torches up into the sky,

units.source_text: 送别在空中游荡的鬼魂回阴府，后来由此演变成在山上焚火。

en.t: sending the ghosts wandering in the air back to the underworld; later this developed into lighting fires on the mountains.
